t: The usual source of fuel that will power your Reactors is Yellorite.$(br2)Yellorite can be found in almost all biomes and can be smelted to produce Yellorium ingots.
为反应堆提供动力的常见燃料来源是黄铀。$(br2)黄铀几乎可以在所有生物群系中找到，并且可以通过冶炼制成黄铀锭。
Only found in the extreme recesses of hell, Benitoite crystals have some unusual properties that you still haven't found a use for.
蓝锥矿晶体只出现在地狱最深邃的角落，它们拥有一些不同寻常的性质，而你至今仍未发现它们的用途。
You need to reach the end of your journey to find these elusive crystals, even if you still don't know how you could use them to your advantage.
你需要抵达旅程的终点——末地，才能找到这些难觅的水晶，尽管你依然不知道该如何利用它们。
